ui.title: Xeno Tactics
ui.sub: Maze tower defense inspired by Xeno Tactic · 200 waves
ui.diffNote: Changing difficulty starts a new game. Best results are kept separately for each level.
ui.help1: How to play. Aliens crawl out of two hive breaches (the red glow) and head for the base gates (yellow-and-black stripes). Towers act as walls: build a maze so enemies spend longer under fire. The dashed line shows the route. Flyers ignore the maze and fly straight along the highlighted lane: keep missiles, machine guns, lasers or railguns next to it. Armor reduces the damage of every hit; the laser, railgun, howitzer, burning, abilities and every ultimate tower pierce it.
ui.help2: Upgrades. Levels 1–4 strengthen a tower. At level 5 you pick one of two ultimate specializations, unique to each tower; it costs three times the level-4 upgrade. After that comes endless overclocking: each level gives damage ×1.25 and costs 1.45 times more.
ui.help3: Enemies. From midgame on Normal and above, Healers (heal their neighbors, dangerous in long mazes) and Blinkers (jump ahead along the route) appear, and flyers join ground waves. Stuns and freezes leave the enemy immune for a few seconds.
ui.help4: Abilities cost more with every wave but hit harder too. You win by surviving wave 200 and the Swarm Queen.
ui.help5: Controls. Pick a tower and tap the field. Tap a built tower to upgrade or sell it. For a targeted ability, press its button, then a spot on the field.
ui.help6: Keys: <kbd>1</kbd>–<kbd>8</kbd> towers, <kbd>Q</kbd> <kbd>W</kbd> <kbd>E</kbd> <kbd>R</kbd> <kbd>T</kbd> abilities, <kbd>U</kbd> upgrade or overclock, <kbd>S</kbd> sell, <kbd>Space</kbd> or <kbd>Esc</kbd> pause, <kbd>N</kbd> next wave, <kbd>F</kbd> fast-forward, <kbd>M</kbd> sound. Right-click or picking again clears the selection.

gun.name: Machine Gun
gun.desc: Cheap and fast-firing, hits everything. Weak against armor.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.desc: Range ×1.7, damage ×6, half the fire rate. Targets the toughest enemy

cannon.name: Cannon
cannon.desc: Close-range splash shells. Ground targets only.

shock.name: Concussion
shock.desc: Damage ×2.5, blast ×1.4, stuns for 0.5 s (then 2.5 s of stun immunity)

frost.name: Cryo
frost.desc: A pulse slows every enemy in range.

zero.name: Absolute Zero
zero.desc: Every 3rd pulse freezes for 1.2 s (with immunity), 80% slow, range ×1.4

brittle.name: Brittle
brittle.desc: Enemies in range take +60% damage from everything, range ×1.6

sam.name: Surface-to-Air
sam.desc: Also hits ground units, splash damage

laser.name: Laser
laser.desc: Continuous beam that pierces armor. Damage per second.

heat.name: Overheat
heat.desc: Damage on one target ramps up to ×8 over 4 s, range ×1.3

plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.desc: Plasma bolts set the target on fire. Burning pierces armor.

nova.name: Supernova
nova.desc: The bolt explodes and ignites everything nearby, damage and burn ×2

plague.name: Plague
plague.desc: Burn ×6 and it spreads to neighbors

rail.name: Railgun
rail.desc: An instant shot pierces every enemy in a line.

artillery.name: Howitzer
artillery.desc: 2×2 tower. Long-range fire at the toughest enemy, pierces armor.

nuke.name: Nuclear Shell
nuke.desc: Damage ×7, blast radius 3.5, three times slower

easy.name: Easy
easy.desc: The original balance. No healers or blinkers.

normal.name: Normal
normal.desc: Enemy health up to ×1.9 by midgame, +1 armor. From wave 30: healers, blinkers and flyers mixed into ground waves.

hard.name: Hard
hard.desc: Health up to ×2.5, armor +2 and grows faster, faster enemies, rewards −20%. New enemies from wave 20.

insane.name: Impossible
insane.desc: Health up to ×3.4, armor +4 and grows faster, rewards −30%, 15 lives. Everything starts almost at once.

stasis.name: Stasis
stasis.desc: Every enemy is slowed by 75% for 8 s (Brood Mothers by 40%)

napalm.name: Napalm
napalm.desc: A fire zone for 10 s, burning pierces armor

carpet.name: Carpet Bombing
carpet.desc: A bomber flies along the chosen row
carpet.descRotated: A bomber flies along the chosen column

nuke.name: Nuclear Strike
nuke.desc: After 1.5 s: 35% of health (Brood Mothers 10%) plus heavy damage to everything within radius 4
